profile.headline: Senior Frontend Developer
profile.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (NYSE: JPM) is a leading global financial services firm with assets of $2.4 trillion and operations worldwide. The firm is a leader in investment banking, financial services for consumers and small businesses, commercial banking, financial transaction processing, and asset management. A component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average, JPMorgan Chase & Co. serves millions of consumers in the United States and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under its J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Information about JPMorgan Chase & Co. is available at www.jpmorganchase.com.

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.locationName: Mt Laurel, New Jersey, United States

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
o	Performed full development life cycle of products features using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery.
o	Developed rich user interface using AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML and CSS. 
o	Worked closely with Business Analysts in understanding the technical requirements of the project.
o	Created the Configurator system for shirts & suits category which revolutionized the way of wearing suits.
o	Embedded various social media into the website like FB, Twitter and Google+.
o	Responsible for updating the Landing Pages for desktop and responsive using HTML4/5, CSS and Object Oriented JavaScript. 	
o	Responsible for creating the first magazine for Brooks Brothers consisting of various effects using JQuery, HTML and CSS.
o	Wrote extensive HTML/HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript code to build dynamic pages using Eclipse IDE.
o	Built the JavaScript functions to manage forms, database connections, error management, permissions, reporting. 
o	JavaScript and CSS compression using YUI Compressor.
o	Improved performance of the webpages and overall website by following best practices.
o	Created and tested scripts using JQuery on various browsers Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Safari and IE.
o	Used various CSS frameworks including Twitter BootStrap and jQuery UI.
o	Used Subversion as the versioning tool
o	Monitored and resolved bug fixes using BugZilla.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
o	Studied the scope of the Project and scaled the estimates with the Design Team.
o	Effectively interacted with Design Team members, and contributed to LL Design and Interaction Sequence Flows.
o	Implemented the Model View Control (MVC) design pattern using JSP, Servlets, and JavaBeans to control the flow of the application in the Presentation/Web tier.
o	Used Log4J to logging, debugging, and providing warning and info on the server console.
o	Designed and developed application using AGILE/SCRUM methodology.
o	Written configuration scripts to setup the account information for various data transformation processes. 
o	Gather business requirements, design and document technical design for the business requirements.
o	Involved extensively in OO analysis/design and generated Class, Sequence diagrams for designing using UML, OOAD, and Design Patterns.
o	Developed DAO based Java Beans and Utility Classes for interacting with the database using JDBC.
o	Used SQL statements and procedures to fetch the data from the database.
o	Using team track, defect tracking system for reporting defects and requesting builds.
o	Involved in coding JUnit test cases for unit testing and performed integration testing.
